framework: vanilla HTML + ES modules (index.html, app.js, src/*.js); no build step
font_stack: system-ui stack (styles.css :root --font) + ui-monospace (--mono); no web fonts, no network font dependency
palette: hex custom properties in styles.css :root — dark paper (#07070b), cyan #2fe0e6 + magenta #ff3d86 accents, medal gold/silver/bronze
motion: motion-cut — no framer-motion / gsap / motion / lenis; CSS transitions only
spacing: ad-hoc rem values; no formal 4pt scale
notes: Existing app has test-enforced CSS contracts (67 tests, node --test). No design.md / tokens.css / prior .hallmark log.
